# test\-helper

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments-bots/cmd/test-helper"
```

Command test\-helper keeps one GitHub issue per test file of a repository and posts each test run's results to it.

A test file is a \*\_test.go file under tests/ \(tests/data excluded\) that declares Go test functions or top\-level Ginkgo containers. Its issue is titled "\[test\] \<path under tests/ without .go\>" and labelled test\-tracking.

```
test-helper sync     open an issue for every test file that has none
test-helper report   comment each file's results on its issue
```

GitHub is reached with the token in GH\_TOKEN \(or GITHUB\_TOKEN\), normally an installation token of the BlanketOps\-Environments App.
